name: Wirtshaus am Neunerköpfle
kurzbeschreibung: **The Neunerköpfle Inn in Tannheim** – a cozy mountain tavern nestled in the heart of the **Tannheim Valley**, where hearty **Tiroler** hospitality meets rustic charm. Savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Käsespätzle**, paired with crisp local beers and crisp **Tiroler** wines. Enjoy panoramic views of the **Lechquellengebirge** while unwinding in a warm, wood-paneled setting. Whether you're craving a hearty meal, a cold drink, or just a moment of relaxation, this hidden gem is the perfect retreat after a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, it’s an ideal stop for travelers seeking an authentic taste of alpine life.
